title: Our story
tagline: Every success begins with an idea in a person's mind.

sections.heading: Ideals are rooted in ideas
sections.body: The company began by providing advanced surgical laser and radiofrequency technologies to Iranian physicians. Today those devices operate in hospitals, clinics and wellness centres across the country.

sections.heading: Our mission
sections.body: We consider it our mission to believe in teamwork and to rely on our loyal, committed and responsible human capital. We aim to offer physician-guided products that enable medical information to be shared globally and healthcare to advance.

sections.heading: Our vision
sections.body: We strive to maintain our customers' trust and to provide consultation on world-renowned brands, positioning ourselves as a reference for proper consultation and for choosing the best available option.

sections.heading: Our values
sections.body: Ashkan Medical Idea is committed to delivering innovative healthcare solutions and to promoting national healthcare culture through cutting-edge medical technologies.

proof_point: More than 90% of the doctors and specialists who have engaged with us have returned for the latest technologies after purchasing their first treatment centre.

ceo.name: Ashkan Eghbal Ahmadi
ceo.statement: Organizational health, expertise, customer satisfaction and innovation have been the core operating principles across two decades in medical equipment.
